# Amager og Hvidovre Hospital

Amager og Hvidovre Hospital is one of Denmark's largest treatment centers for inflammatory bowel disease, operating as a major hub within the Danish national inflammatory bowel disease registry (DANIBD). As of the 2023–2024 reporting period, the hospital was managing 1,117 patients undergoing biologic treatment (BMSL), with Crohn's disease accounting for 715 patients (64%) and ulcerative colitis representing 396 patients (35%)[^src1].

The hospital's role is documented within the DANIBD registry, which tracks patient characteristics, biologic drug treatment patterns, surgical procedures, and comorbidities such as primary sclerosing cholangitis across Danish hospitals and treatment centers serving both children and adults[^src1]. Amager og Hvidovre Hospital's patient cohort reflects the broader Danish experience of inflammatory bowel disease management during the October 2023 to September 2024 period.
